parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotency of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch update-instance-settings --instance-id es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000 --update-strategy normal --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --es-config thread_pool.write.queue_size=500 --biz-force true --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun elasticsearch POST /openapi/instances/es-cn-nif1q9o8r00080000/instance-settings --region cn-hangzhou --updateStrategy normal --clientToken '5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000' --force true --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body {"esConfig":{"thread_pool.write.queue_size":500}}
